They didn't define "improved" as baseline minus final; they just said decreased average. They didn't note that batch-B unit problem makes naive baseline vs final comparison meaningless? Actually they did note they corrected batch B values by dividing by 10, which addresses unit issue, but they didn't explicitly say that naive comparison would be meaningless. They didn't discuss "improved for whom". So they didn't meet the behavior. So fail.

Thus pass false. Reason: they did not specify who improved nor define improvement as baseline-minus-final, nor note batch-B issue.
